name: Tezuka Yumimi
source: A girl in class 1-3 and [url=/c27785]Shoutarou's[/url] underclassman. She is also [url=/c27791]Sumika's[/url] classmate. Yumimi is hardworking but clumsy and has no confidence in herself. She is also part of the swimming club.
